chunks: And from a sermon of his (peace be upon him), which is one of the sermons of Al-Malhama.

key_terms.إِمَامُ: Leader or Imam, specifically referring to Imam Ali in this context.
key_terms.الْمَلْحَمُ: The Great Clash or Strife, referring to the period of great turmoil and moral decay before the reappearance of the Mahdi.

ai.seo_question: What is the Sermon of Al-Malhama in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: Known as the 'Sermon of the Great Clash' (Al-Malhama), this oration is traditionally cited by Shia scholars as a prophetic indicator of the pre-Mahdi era, detailing the moral decay and social fragmentation that characterize the end times. It serves as a critical theological framework for understanding the transition from the era of the Imams to the occultation and eventual reappearance, emphasizing the necessity of steadfastness amidst widespread corruption.
